title: M3CV: Multi-subject, Multi-session, Multi-task EEG Database
description: M3CV is a multi-subject, multi-session, multi-task EEG database with 64-channel recordings from 95 healthy young adults. Each subject was recorded on two different days across six paradigms covering 13 distributed signal types: resting states, motor execution, transient visual, auditory and somatosensory responses, SSVEP, P300, SSAEP and SSSEP. The data were originally released for an EEG-based biometrics competition on Kaggle. This BIDS version reconstructs pseudo-continuous EEG from the distributed pre-epoched, preprocessed 250 Hz files.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier and a 64-channel Easycap (10-20 layout) at 1000 Hz, with FCz as online reference. Visual, auditory and vibrotactile stimuli were delivered with Psychtoolbox-3 and Arduino. Data were preprocessed in Matlab/Letswave7: bad-channel interpolation, 0.01-200 Hz bandpass, 50 Hz notch, linked-mastoid re-referencing, ICA removal of ocular artifacts, and downsampling to 250 Hz. The result was distributed as 4-second epochs, which were concatenated per subject, session and task for this BIDS version.
